description: This header defines the CycleClock class and related functions for accessing a cycle counter with an approximately constant rate, including methods to get current cycle count and frequency, and to register alternate sources. It is part of the Abseil library's internal base implementation.

classes.name: CycleClock
classes.description: Provides static methods to access cycle counter value and frequency, and to register alternate sources.

classes.name: CycleClockSource
classes.description: Allows registration of custom cycle counter source functions.

methods.name: CycleClock::Now
methods.description: Returns the current cycle count value.

methods.name: CycleClock::Frequency
methods.description: Returns the frequency of the cycle counter in cycles per second.

methods.name: CycleClockSource::Register
methods.description: Registers an alternate source function for the cycle counter.
